Description: Polymarket V7 London PAPER/SHADOW three-AZ benchmark; no inbound access and no real-order authority.

ExpectedSha.Description: Immutable exact Git SHA to bootstrap.

ImageId.Description: Canonical Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 AMI selected by the provisioning wrapper.

Properties.GroupDescription: No inbound; outbound-only London PAPER benchmark hosts

Fn::Base64.Fn::Sub:
#!/bin/bash
set -euxo pipefail
exec > >(tee -a /var/log/polymarket-v7-london-bootstrap.log | logger -t polymarket-v7-london -s 2>/dev/console) 2>&1
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl git snapd
if ! command -v amazon-ssm-agent >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  snap install amazon-ssm-agent --classic || true
fi
systemctl enable --now snap.amazon-ssm-agent.amazon-ssm-agent.service 2>/dev/null ||   systemctl enable --now amazon-ssm-agent.service 2>/dev/null || true
mkdir -p /mnt/polymarket-data
DATA_DEV="$(lsblk -bndo NAME,TYPE,SIZE,MOUNTPOINT | awk '$2=="disk" && $3>=200000000000 && $4=="" {print "/dev/"$1; exit}')"
if [ -n "$DATA_DEV" ]; then
  if ! blkid "$DATA_DEV" >/dev/null 2>&1; then mkfs.ext4 -F "$DATA_DEV"; fi
  UUID="$(blkid -s UUID -o value "$DATA_DEV")"
  grep -q "UUID=$UUID " /etc/fstab || echo "UUID=$UUID /mnt/polymarket-data ext4 defaults,nofail,noatime 0 2" >> /etc/fstab
  mount /mnt/polymarket-data || true
fi
chown -R ${ServiceUser}:${ServiceUser} /mnt/polymarket-data
curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ENRICOBIGNOZZI/Polymarket/${ExpectedSha}/ops/v7_london_bootstrap.sh" -o /tmp/v7_london_bootstrap.sh
chmod 0755 /tmp/v7_london_bootstrap.sh
POLYMARKET_EXPECTED_SHA="${ExpectedSha}" POLYMARKET_SERVICE_USER="${ServiceUser}" POLYMARKET_APP_DIR="/home/${ServiceUser}/polymarket" PM_V7_RUN_ROOT="/mnt/polymarket-data/paper_v7_london" POLYMARKET_INSTALL_TAILSCALE=1 /tmp/v7_london_bootstrap.sh
